question: Which of the following contains the largest amount of fresh water on earth?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ice caps.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **An ice cap is a glacier, a thick layer of ice and snow, that covers fewer than 50,000 square kilometers (19,000 square miles)**.
 
• **Ice and glaciers **are part of the **water cycle**, even though the **water in them moves very slowly.**
 
• An** ice cap** is **a thick layer of ice and snow that covers large areas of land**&
